usageNotes: Use this endpoint to get a cross-remote leaderboard of the highest-consuming VMs/containers (guest-cpu), hypervisor nodes (node-cpu), and hypervisor nodes by RAM (node-memory) — useful for capacity planning and identifying runaway workloads across all remotes in one call. Each result entry includes both the current resource snapshot and an RRD time-series for the chosen timeframe, so omitting 'timeframe' returns only point-in-time data without historical trend. Only remotes and resources for which the authenticated user holds Resource.Audit on /resource/{remote_name} are included; remotes without that privilege are silently excluded from the rankings.

examples.summary: Get top CPU/memory consumers over the past day across all remotes

tips: RRD data points may contain null values for intervals where no sample was collected; handle sparse arrays in the client.
The 'view' parameter scopes results to a named PDM view — omit it to query across all remotes the token can see.
CPU values (cpu field) are fractional utilization ratios (0.0–1.0 per vCPU allocated), not percentages.
Results are returned pre-sorted descending by utilization; no client-side sorting is needed.
